summary: Gauzy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter for delaying its 2025 Form 20-F. The company has 60 days to submit a compliance plan and up to 180 days to cure. This is a routine exchange notice regarding late filing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing is procedural, reporting a listing standards matter without triggering any deal, tender, or restructuring. The registrant's role is simply as the issuer filing the notice.
